# Pixel Poll

A simple offline browser app where you vote on a question with 4 options. Vote by clicking an option, see vote counts and percentage bars, change your vote by clicking another option, and reset all votes with the Reset button.

## Features

- 4 options with live vote counts and percentage bars
- Click to vote; click another option to change your vote
- Reset votes button
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Cohesive dark palette with pixel-art inspired colors

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or network needed.

## Files

- `index.html` – structure
- `style.css` – styling
- `script.js` – logic
